Hi Soojin,

Greenleaf is preparing to process the renewal and expand committed capacity (we're planning to bump to 3x reserved instances for Q3). Procurement needs an up-to-date vendor onboarding packet and a completed SOW so we can submit to finance. Two asks:  

- Can you upload the latest SOW & W-9/KYC to our procurement portal (we prefer the portal record so approvals route automatically): https://procurement.greenleaf.ai/portal/form/12345
- If there are term changes or signature pages that need Legal review, please let me know — procurement will not kick the PO without the fully executed docs.

We aim to get this into the March PO cycle (submit by 2026-03-05). Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Hi all — quick technical note from CS.

Provisioning ETA: once the PO is processed and signed SOW is returned, we typically schedule capacity increase within 3 business days. No customer-side maintenance window required for the reserved capacity bump; the change is handled transparently. If Greenleaf is using on-prem connectors we will coordinate, but for cloud-hosted instances there should be zero downtime.

I'll mark the provisioning ETA in the portal record and follow up in the mutual action plan.
